4754fc66-6bcb-4cc3-98ec-10f585cc55f3.title: Moto-Sekai Ichii Sub-chara Ikusei Nikki ~Hi-Player, Isekai wo Kouryaku-chu!~
4754fc66-6bcb-4cc3-98ec-10f585cc55f3.altTitle: The Former Top 1's Sub-Character Training Diary: A Dedicated Player is Currently Conquering Another World!
4754fc66-6bcb-4cc3-98ec-10f585cc55f3.description:
The protagonist who was rarely ever at school during his middle school and high school days, is unemployed even as an adult. From morning till night, it was video games. For him who was ranked first worldwide, it was his life. One day, his character is suddenly hacked. The data was unrecoverable and there was nothing that could be done. Feeling great despair at having lost his rank that he had bet everything to achieve in a world that controlled his life, the protagonist attempts suicide.

When he awakens, he finds himself inside the video game, no, it was a real world that resembled it. There, he notices that he has reincarnated into the the body of a sub character that he had created and bought premium benefits for long ago but had left neglected.

0c3e20da-6f48-468f-bf92-755ee46e05ec.title: Jaeanggeum Yeongungnimi Gwihwanhasyeotda
0c3e20da-6f48-468f-bf92-755ee46e05ec.description:
Twenty years.

For twenty long years, the thirteenth saint Lee Geon was trapped inside the Tower of Demons after being backstabbed by twelve of his allies. These twelve "saints" were warriors chosen by the twelve Zodiac gods to defeat mysterious monsters called "calamities" that were massacring the planet. Though no god had chosen Geon as a saint, he became the mightiest of them all, which made him a hero... and a target.

But now, Geon has brawled his way out of the tower, and he's back stronger than ever. All that's left is to exact brutal payback on each of the saints, but none of these powerful beings will go down without a fight.

Will Geon be able to stay in one piece while achieving the divine revenge of his dreams?

4536960e-a1a4-46c9-bb76-7604523f79fa.title: Corrupting the Heroine's First Love
4536960e-a1a4-46c9-bb76-7604523f79fa.altTitle: Corrupting Your Heroine's First Love Will Result With This
4536960e-a1a4-46c9-bb76-7604523f79fa.description:
“I am a knight of Latem. We’re not destined to stand under the same sky.”

She had become Karina Apocalita, the personification of evil and a member of the heterogeneous race that ruled the world with malevolence. The plot began to twist and turn when Karina unknowingly saved the life of Reneiger, a justful knight and the heroine’s first love.

Reneiger became doubtful of his faith, eventually losing his glow and radiant platinum blond. Soon the sacred knight fell from grace and aligned himself to Karina’s fate.

“There’s no turning back now. Dear God, please forgive me.”

He knew he would never be able to escape from her hands.

---
"I am a knight of Latem, and that means I cannot coexist under the same sky as you."

After entering the book *A Trapped Bird Cannot Escape*, I realized that I had taken over the body of Karina Apocalypta, a member of a species that reigns as the evil of the world. However, the novel's plot begins to twist after I saved the life of Reneiger, the first love of the female protagonist, who happens to be a holy knight. Reneiger begins to doubt his faith, ultimately losing his brilliant platinum hair. Thus, the once sacred holy knight turns corrupt and eventually sympathizes with Karina's fate...

"Now we have each other's desires," Karina said while caressing his cheek. It was a feeling of being pulled in by each fascinating tendril of thorny vines.

Reneiger couldn't bear it, "It can't be undone."

---
In a land overshadowed by darkness, Karina Apocalita rises as a formidable figure, her being a tapestry of power from a diverse race. Her destiny intertwines with Reneiger, a knight from the virtuous Latem order, known for justice and as the former love of a legendary heroine. Their paths take an unforeseen turn when Karina, unaware of her impact, saves Reneiger's life. This act, challenging his convictions, triggers a crisis within him, tarnishing his once radiant aura and precipitating a fall from grace.

Faced with his altered fate, Reneiger prays for forgiveness, realizing his escape from Karina's shadow is but a dream. This pivotal moment raises a haunting question: will Reneiger rediscover the light, or be consumed by the darkness emanating from Karina?

db84bc96-05db-4022-9b61-11982f67c18e.title: Anne Shirley
db84bc96-05db-4022-9b61-11982f67c18e.description:
Anne is an orphan taken by the middle-aged siblings, Marilla and Matthew Cuthbert, in Avonloa on the bautiful Canadian island of Price Edward Island.
With a pure heart and an extraordinary imagination that help her endure her harsh upbrinding, Anne always looks on the bright side, even when she makes mistakes!
Her determination to face any challenge gradually begins to change the hearts of those around her.
Skinny and with freckles, this red-haired girl is surrounded by breathtaking nature, the simple joys of of life, and a heart-fluttering romance...

A manga adaptation of the 2025 anime of the same name, itself an adaptation of the "Anne of Green Gables" book series by Lucy Maud Montgomery.

0444af1a-9efc-4943-bbd3-1e5b1ab7a22f.title: Juhui ui Juwi
0444af1a-9efc-4943-bbd3-1e5b1ab7a22f.description:
Minni can see ghosts. And Juhee was once her closest childhood friend.
Whenever Minni was with Juhee, she couldn’t see ghosts, so she was able to grow up like a normal person. But due to an unexplained accident, Juhee died at a young age.
At least, that’s what Minni believed… until she reunites with her in high school, alive and well.
But the Juhee she once knew is nowhere to be found, and something about her feels off.

8715a978-d873-4398-8061-b959f72bea58.description:
The war of the Northern Xia lasted less than half a year. The war ended in victory for the Zhongyuan army, but in the process, Bai Lixue's family is devastated by a demonic cult.
He lost both his parents and siblings.
The only survivor, Bai Li Gang has only one goal... the complete annihilation of the demonic cult!

89ed3ec2-ebe6-4d6b-92eb-d753a8bb365e.title: Rougo ni Sonaete Isekai de 8-manmai no Kinka wo Tamemasu
89ed3ec2-ebe6-4d6b-92eb-d753a8bb365e.altTitle: Saving 80,000 Gold Coins in the Different World for My Old Age
89ed3ec2-ebe6-4d6b-92eb-d753a8bb365e.description:
After growing up an orphan, Mitsuha has a healthy respect for money and a desire to live well—at least, until she dies after being pushed off a cliff. Waking up in a strange fantasy world, Mitsuha narrowly survives an encounter with a pack of wolves, then realizes she has the power to move between this world and the real one. A lesser person might embark on heroic adventures—Mitsuha instead immediately recognizes the lucrative possibilities of her new situation, and heads out to buy an arsenal of modern weapons. Her goal: to acquire 80,000 gold, and the life of leisure she's always dreamed of!

---
Note: The English language translation has a different numbering as they group short chapters together into one chapter.
